basics.name: Ryan Wendell
basics.label: Technical Product Engineer
basics.summary: Software engineer with 5 years of experience delivering enterprise features, integrations, and data pipelines while working closely with technical and non-technical stakeholders. Experienced translating business needs into technical requirements and delivery plans, and now transitioning into Technical Product Management.

work.name: Northern Trust
work.summary: Product-focused engineering role driving end-to-end feature delivery and serving as liaison between technical squads and non-technical stakeholders.
highlights: Spearheaded the end-to-end delivery of large-scale features for global partners, serving as the primary liaison between technical squads and non-technical stakeholders to align progress with strategic timelines.
Facilitated all Agile ceremonies (Sprint Planning, Stand-ups, Retrospectives) during PM absences, ensuring consistent velocity and backlog health for high-priority initiatives.
Conducted interviews with internal and external users to define business logic and API specifications, translating high-level business needs into detailed technical roadmaps.
Managed the development of data pipelines processing 2.5M daily transactions, ensuring product stability and high-performance throughput for enterprise users.
Directed the development of automated visualization tools and diagnostic utilities, reducing system regressions and improving the overall stability and UX for global partners.
Established and documented troubleshooting frameworks and maintenance processes to ensure seamless internal knowledge transfer and long-term product support.

work.name: BluBracket (acquired by HashiCorp)
work.summary: Product-focused consulting role defining requirements for security dashboards and overseeing implementation of testing suites and accessibility compliance.
highlights: Collaborated with cross-functional departments to define requirements for a centralized security dashboard, prioritizing features based on vulnerability detection accuracy and enterprise risk-scoring needs.
Oversaw the implementation of comprehensive testing suites and accessibility (a11y) compliance, ensuring a reliable and inclusive experience for diverse user groups.
Partnered with security analysts and developers to resolve critical logic flaws in scoring algorithms, directly improving data integrity for enterprise clients.

work.name: Impact Networking, LLC
work.summary: Delivered automation solutions for diverse client portfolio, identifying workflow bottlenecks and translating requirements into tailored technical solutions.
highlights: Orchestrated full-stack automation solutions for a diverse portfolio of clients, including a non-profit medical organization, ensuring compliance with specialized workflow requirements.
Streamlined enterprise workflows across HR, fundraising, and OCR departments by identifying manual bottlenecks and delivering tailored .NET and SQL automation solutions.
